response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with 13+ years across web, mobile, and distributed systems, but the profile does not match the core requirement of this role: hands-on senior-level C++ development. C++ experience appears limited to roughly seven months at National Instruments in 2014-2015 and a university thesis project; C++ is not even listed in the skills section. There is no evidence of industrial automation, IEC 62443/SDL security practice, MQTT or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850), message-broker-based C++ architectures, or Azure cloud work. The relevant transferable strengths — low-latency asynchronous services in D, event-driven platform design, mentoring and testing rigor — are real but would require substantial ramp-up on both the language and the industrial cybersecurity domain that the role treats as essential.
strengths: Deep experience building low-latency, high-throughput, event-driven distributed services
Strong software craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, and active mentoring/teaching
Broad full-stack range including Node.js, React/Ember, Docker, and Kubernetes deployments
concerns: Minimal, decade-old C++/STL experience; C++ absent from stated skill set
No industrial automation, IoT, MQTT, or industrial protocol (Modbus/OPC UA) background
No exposure to SDL, IEC 62443, or secure engineering standards; no Azure experience

key_factors.factor: Industrial automation and security standards domain gap
